author: Caitlin Sangrey
text: I highly recommend Blue Star Septic Service.! From start to finish the communication was prompt and professional.  Had a full septic tank that was backing up. This was an emergency to get it pumped. I spent the morning calling every company i could find and had zero luck. Some never called me back and others said they couldn't do it for weeks.  Blue Star called me back immediately and went out of there way to help me today. Great customer service. They knew the urgency of my situation. Nick came out to my home  very quickly this morning. I highly recommend this local family business. I kindly thank them for their service  today and in the future.

author: Tabatha Peters, Realtor
text: I can't thank Jason at  Blue Star Septic Service, enough for his prompt and professional response. He quickly adjusted his schedule to address an issue, ensuring everything stayed on track for a critical real estate deal. His reliability and dedication were instrumental in keeping the transaction moving forward. He took the time to answer questions and concerns. Highly recommend their services for anyone in need of fast, dependable help.

author: Kimberly Stamm
text: I contacted five local businesses that elicited 24 hour service, however I only found one to address my needs. I believe his name was Tyler, he walked me through how to fix my septic issue while we were on the phone. He was super patient and very helpful. He saved me an expensive service call, which he was not obligated to do. He walked me though a few steps that allowed me to fix my clog septic myself while educating me through the guided process. Everyone I spoke to was extremely knowledgeable and very kind. I highly recommend Blue Star Septic to receive five GOLD stars! Thank you for your help!!  Good assertive business sense with a hand shake and a call me if you need anything “attitude”... hard to find now a days!

author: David Graubard
text:
Jason and his team did an excellent job replacing my old septic system that was failing and starting to give us some major problems.

This company was very patient and attentive in addressing all of my concerns and questions about the installation process. They also were quick to respond to fix my old system long enough to get us through until our new system was installed.

author: Amanda Reinecker
text: If I could give this company zero stars I would. Called and set up pumping, receptionist wasn't in office (totally understandable) said would call in about 4t min when she was back in the office. She did! So it was great.... until I never got service the week I was supposed to. Talk to her again 2 business days later (there was a Monday holiday so I wanted to give them a little slack) but not only does she want to act like she has no idea who I am, says she barely remembers speaking to me and wants to claim she never called me back that day. So which is it? Do you suck at scheduling? Or do you have that bad of customer service you "don't call people back!?" Either way your company sucks then. And I KNOW FOR A FACT you called me back. I might be busy like all mom's, but I'm not crazy.... and to sit on the phone and say you kind of remember but didn't call me back? Either way you just made your business sound like a joke.
